news.title: New Harvesters CEO and President Credits Jesuit Values for Shaping Her Journey
news.summary_en: In June, Debbie Espinosa, ’98, was announced as the next president and CEO of Harvesters—The Community Food Network, a regional food bank based in Kansas City. It’s both a new challenge and a familiar role for Espinosa, who credited previous experience in the nonprofit sector and her Jesuit education at Rockhurst University for preparing her well to take the helm.
